changeSet.sql: UPDATE fixed_date_range fdr SET timezone = fdr_timezone.timezone FROM ( SELECT DISTINCT w.timezone as timezone, w.id as w_id, wfr.warning_id as wfr_id, fdr.parent_id as fdr_parent_id, wfr.id as wfr_id FROM warning w INNER JOIN warning_feature_part wfr ON w.id = wfr.warning_id INNER JOIN fixed_date_range fdr ON fdr.parent_id = wfr.id ) AS fdr_timezone WHERE fdr.parent_id = fdr_timezone.fdr_parent_id;

changeSet.sql: insert into warning_locality_names(id, warning_id, parent_id, name, international_name, position) select gen_random_uuid(), wl.warning_id, sar.parent_id, sa.name, coalesce(sa.international_name, sa.name), wl.position from warning_locality wl, sub_area sa, sub_area_relationship sar where sa.id = wl.sub_area_id and sar.sub_areas_id = wl.sub_area_id;

changeSet.sql: CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION get_feature_part_date_range( _position INTEGER, _date_start DATE, _time_of_day_start TIME, _date_end DATE, _time_of_day_end TIME, _timezone TEXT ) RETURNS jsonb AS $$ BEGIN RETURN ( SELECT distinct jsonb_build_object( 'position', _position, 'date_start', CASE WHEN _time_of_day_start IS NOT NULL THEN format_date_or_time(_date_start, _time_of_day_start, _timezone)::DATE ELSE _date_start END, 'time_of_day_start', CASE WHEN _time_of_day_start IS NOT NULL THEN format_date_or_time(_date_start, _time_of_day_start, _timezone)::TIME END, 'date_end', CASE WHEN _time_of_day_end IS NOT NULL THEN format_date_or_time(_date_end, _time_of_day_end, _timezone)::DATE ELSE _date_end END, 'time_of_day_end', CASE WHEN _time_of_day_end IS NOT NULL THEN format_date_or_time(_date_end, _time_of_day_end, _timezone)::TIME END ) ); END; $$ LANGUAGE plpgsql;

changeSet.sql: UPDATE fixed_date_range fdr SET date_start = CASE WHEN time_of_day_start IS NOT NULL THEN format_date_range_from_utc_to_timezone(fdr.date_start, fdr.time_of_day_start, fdr.timezone)::DATE ELSE fdr.date_start END, time_of_day_start = CASE WHEN time_of_day_start IS NOT NULL THEN format_date_range_from_utc_to_timezone(fdr.date_start, fdr.time_of_day_start, fdr.timezone)::TIME ELSE fdr.time_of_day_start END, date_end = CASE WHEN time_of_day_end IS NOT NULL THEN format_date_range_from_utc_to_timezone(fdr.date_end, fdr.time_of_day_end, fdr.timezone)::DATE ELSE fdr.date_end END, time_of_day_end = CASE WHEN time_of_day_end IS NOT NULL THEN format_date_range_from_utc_to_timezone(fdr.date_end, fdr.time_of_day_end, fdr.timezone)::TIME ELSE fdr.time_of_day_end END;
